what.text: This page follows refugees from Ukraine living in Belarus, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 40561 Ukrainian refugees in Belarus, 0.8% of all refugees from Ukraine.
The largest numbers of Ukrainian refugees live in Germany, Poland, Czechia and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025, at war level in every year.
Before that, it records armed conflict over Novorossiya territory in Ukraine from 2014 to 2022, with the DPR, the LPR and the United Armed Forces of Novorossiya.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2014 at 284 refugees.
The figure reached its highest point, 43114, at the end of 2024, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Belarus.
These are year-end totals for Belarus only, reported to UNHCR.
